author: Claude (claude-opus-5-5), logged-in subscription session; no API keys, no paid calls
scope: Microsoft Outlook calendar operational tasks not answered by the 73 baseline pages, Claude batches 01-02, Codex batches, the keyword-agent claims or Argon's shift/time-zone claims.
lessonsAppliedFromReview01: Scope every procedure to client (new Outlook / classic Outlook / Outlook on the web / Outlook.com / Mac / mobile) and account type (work or school vs personal Microsoft account); never assume all modern clients behave alike.
Prefer raw cached primary bodies (claude/review-source-text, primary-source-text) over WebFetch summaries where they exist; WebFetch summaries are flagged as such in records.
Report source ambiguity instead of resolving it; label example timings as illustrations.

Save this setting for future appointments and meetings.') is ambiguous about existing vs new items, and the separate 'Change the default reminder time' page does not resolve it. Held rather than guessed.
